title: Figure 25: Time-irreversibility of light propagation inside a twisted fiber core
description: Line plot of normalized mode power |a_co|^2, |a_cl|^2 versus fiber length (0-500 mm), with purple lines for left-to-right propagation and red solid and dashed lines for the reflected core and cladding modes; black arrows indicate direction.
